messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nimbushealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Rebecca Stone <rebecca.stone@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice tranches & proposed drawdown timeline

Hi Dylan,

Attaching the tranche breakdown we discussed for the annual prepay commitment (Q3 start). We split the committed amount into three tranches to align with our internal milestones and cash planning. Key points:
- Tranche 1: $250k invoice on 2027-06-03 (covers sprint 1/4)
- Tranche 2: $250k invoice on 2027-09-01 (post sprint review)
- Tranche 3: $300k invoice on 2028-01-03 (final sweep)

We plan to initiate the first drawdown from our corporate card / treasury on 2027-06-07. Please confirm whether Redwood will issue a PDF invoice dated 2027-06-03 and whether VAT should be shown on the invoice or handled as a separate tax credit note (we are EU HQ'd but US billing).

Attachment: Nimbus_Invoice_Tranches_2027Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet with line-item mapping to sprint milestones)

Thanks,
Alex
Account Lead, Nimbus Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice tranches & proposed drawdown timeline

Thanks Alex — got the tranche sheet and skimmed the milestones. A few quick clarifications so we don’t block payments:

1) Invoice timing: we can generate the PDF invoice dated 2027-06-03 as requested. Marissa / Marcus, can you confirm the cut for the first invoice and whether we need a separate invoice per tranche or a single invoice with payment schedule?

2) VAT / tax: Nimbus noted EU HQ but US billing. Do we show VAT on the invoice (no VAT registration in US) or leave it net and provide a tax/credit note if they need it for EU reclaim?

3) PO & approvals: Alex, can you confirm the PO number or provide a short DocuSign for the SOW? If you prefer, we can generate an SOW and push to DocuSign — that will speed procurement.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
- Today: Redwood confirms invoice format + VAT handling (internal finance)
- Mon 31-May: Nimbus returns PO or signs SOW via DocuSign
- Thu 03-Jun: Redwood issues invoice (Tranche 1)
- Mon 07-Jun: Nimbus initiates drawdown

If that timeline works, I’ll loop in finance to prepare the invoice and the signed SOW workflow.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Nimbus Health — need invoice approach + VAT note (internal)

Team — forwarding Nimbus tranche sheet. They want the first invoice dated 2027-06-03 and will draw funds 2027-06-07. Questions for finance:
- Do we issue three separate invoices on the dates Alex listed, or one invoice with three line items and scheduled payments? Procurement prefers discrete invoices for each tranche to tie to sprints; accounting might prefer a single document with scheduled payments.
- VAT: customer is EU HQ but billing in US. Should we show 0% VAT with a tax attribution note, or omit VAT on the invoice and create a separate credit note if needed? Any global tax implications?
- Do we need a signed SOW before billing? They indicated they can sign DocuSign today. If we need a hard-signed copy to release tranche 1, call it out.

Attachments: Nimbus_Invoice_Tranches_2027Q3.xlsx (from customer)

Marissa: can you confirm who owns the invoice generation and the accounting flow/GL codes so Marcus can book the deferment schedule? Priyom: please flag any collections cadence notes — they plan to draw 4 days after invoice date.

Thanks,
Dylan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nimbus Health — need invoice approach + VAT note (internal)

Dylan / Marcus — I reviewed the tranche sheet. Ops notes:
- We will issue three separate invoices on the dates requested. That aligns better with AR reconciliations and their procurement asks.
- VAT: since invoice will be issued to the US legal entity, we should show no VAT on the face of the invoice and add the following invoice footer: "Tax treatment: US-sourced invoice; no VAT charged. Customer to apply local reclaim per local tax rules." If Nimbus provides EU VAT registration details and requests VAT on an EU invoice, we can re-issue a credit/adjustment.
- SOW: Procurement requires an executed SOW for the committed amount. I see a DocuSign link referenced in their note. Please ask Alex to confirm completed signature; we’ll hold the first invoice until DocuSign returns a completed envelope (standard internal control).

Marcus: GL coding for the prepay should be booked to Deferred Revenue (LIAB-Prepay-Annual) and we will amortize monthly based on usage sweep. I’ll prepare the invoice templates and email a draft PDF for review by EOD Tue.

Attachments: Signed_SOW_Nimbus_2027.pdf (placeholder — will grab final envelope once Alex confirms)

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
